title: Vacuum gripper with a plurality of longitudinal isolating elements

features.item: A housing with a grip portion for gripping and an electrically operated vacuum generating device
features.quote: The present invention is related to a vacuum gripper for the machine handling of objects, with a housing (1) where a vacuum can be applied through at least one channel
features.note: The reference discloses a housing where vacuum can be applied, but does not explicitly mention an electrically operated vacuum generating device or a specific grip portion for gripping, though it implies handling.

features.item: The grip portion is a hollow body
features.note: The reference does not describe any grip portion as a hollow body.

features.item: Exhaust air from the vacuum generating device is guided through the grip portion to an air outlet
features.note: The reference does not describe exhaust air being guided through a grip portion to an air outlet.

features.item: A sound-damping device is arranged in the grip portion
features.note: The reference does not mention a sound-damping device in any part of the gripper, let alone a grip portion.

features.item: A grip unit with hollow grip portion, electrically operated vacuum generator, exhaust air routed through grip to outlet, and sound-damping device in grip portion
features.note: The reference does not disclose a grip unit with all these combined features, particularly the hollow grip portion, exhaust routing through it, and a sound-damping device.

features.item: A vacuum handling apparatus comprising a suction plate with carrier plate and seal, and a grip unit with hollow grip portion, electrically operated vacuum generator, exhaust air routed through grip to outlet, and sound-damping device
features.note: The reference describes a vacuum gripper but does not include a suction plate with carrier plate and seal, nor the specific grip unit features.

features.item: The grip portion is at least partially lined with sound-damping material
features.note: The reference does not mention any sound-damping material lining a grip portion.

features.item: The vacuum generating device is arranged completely in a first housing portion
features.note: The reference mentions a housing where vacuum can be applied but does not describe a specific vacuum generating device or its arrangement within housing portions.

features.item: A sound-reducing device is arranged in the first housing portion or the first housing portion is lined with sound-reducing material
features.note: The reference does not mention any sound-reducing device or material in any housing portion.

features.item: The grip portion is elongated between the first housing portion and a second housing portion, with air outlet on the second housing portion
features.note: The reference does not describe an elongated grip portion between housing portions with an air outlet on a second portion.

features.item: An air collection screw arranged upstream of the grip portion in the first housing portion for collecting exhaust air
features.note: The reference does not mention an air collection screw or any specific mechanism for collecting exhaust air upstream of a grip portion.

features.item: Bent or curved air baffles downstream of the grip portion for guiding exhaust air to the air outlet
features.note: The reference does not describe bent or curved air baffles for guiding exhaust air.

features.item: A battery coupling point on the second housing portion with air baffles directing exhaust air away from the battery coupling point
features.note: The reference does not mention a battery coupling point or air baffles directing exhaust air away from it.

features.item: The grip unit and suction plate are releasably connected via a coupling device
features.note: The reference describes a vacuum gripper but does not mention a separate grip unit and suction plate that are releasably connected.

features.item: The grip unit has a suction opening fluidically connected to a suction chamber delimited by the suction plate
features.quote: The low pressure that is transmitted from suction joint 3 at suction holes 12 will then draw the gripping element and the object against each other, and the isolating elements will be pushed into the arrangement.
features.note: The reference describes a suction joint and suction holes creating low pressure in an opening/cavity, which functions as a suction chamber, but does not explicitly define a 'grip unit' or 'suction plate' as distinct components.

claims.quote: The figure also shows a hole for flushing 7 of the outer casing 20 and a suction joint 3 in the hollow part 6. The gripper includes an opening or suction part 5, which also appears from the figure.
claims.note: The reference describes a suction opening (5) and a suction joint (3) which creates a vacuum, implying a fluidic connection to a chamber for lifting an object.
claims.refuted: The quote mentions a suction joint and suction opening but does not teach that the opening is fluidically connected to a suction chamber delimited by a suction plate to generate vacuum between the plate and object.

overall.why: The reference describes a vacuum gripper with a housing and movable isolating elements for handling objects, which is broadly related to the subject invention's field of vacuum handling apparatus.
